title: Momoi Airi — Perfect Sweets〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, for today's practice, we'll...
Huh? Just you, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now. Minori said she'll be late because of a committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Same situation as Shizuku then. She said she had to attend a committee meeting too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about we just start with some stretches?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
I'm not sure I thanked you yet, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank me? For what?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For taking last Sunday off so that we could all go out shopping together. Shizuku told me that it was your idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been meaning to tell you how much I appreciated your thought. Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, Shizuku seemed much more concerned than I was and this talk I had with her just sort of ended up with that idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I was able to have a fun day off because of that. I even made an important realization.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So again, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Sigh*... You're such a good kid.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That part of you really hasn't changed since back then. Of course, I mean it all in a good way...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, really. You've always been this idol who could focus on a goal and give it everything you have while you worked away at it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've always admired that part of you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So much so that I kept wondering why I couldn't do what you do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I think you can, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on. Let me finish.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your goal was to give hope to as many people as you could while being the best idol you could be, and you never stopped trying...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You tried so hard that it became a part of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It never occurred to me that I was trying so hard.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I bet. Otherwise, you probably wouldn't have been able to make it this far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On top of that, this is sort of just who you are now. Changing that won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that's also why we want you to relax and be yourself more when you're with us at least.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, but I admire how hard Shizuku works too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Especially the last time I was invited over to her house and saw dumbbells lying around in her room.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look who's talking. I bet you have some at your house too, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, I do...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I knew it...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But Shizuku's told me all about how you train on your own too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? I do what I need to but I don't really do anything special...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I do skip doing homework and stuff some days since I know I can get away with it, while you do your homework everyday, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll go off and do voice training or something instead.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like that counts as having a good work ethic too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haha. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But I think I get it now...
I can try doing things that way from now on.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What way?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not forcing myself to think that I have to do something or get everything done right now. Knowing that I still have time to do things later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Worst case scenario, you can just wait until just before class starts to do any homework that's due.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That might not be for me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I have a better grasp of things now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You do? Great!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll try to look out for myself a little more from now on.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, but... I'm still not entirely sure what I should be doing, so I'd appreciate it if you could help me like you did the other day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you got it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you know, it might be good to talk to Shizuku about that too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's the big sister in her family and has this sort of motherly feel to her. Honestly, just being around her is pretty comforting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She gives off this warmth as if everything will be just fine when you're around her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's even the one who was most concerned about you this time around. I say just talk to her and lean on her more from now on, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I will.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, enough chatting. Let's get back to stretching, shall we...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. I'll press your back while you stretch first, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sure? Well, if you don't mind...!
